title: Landsat 8 Collection 2 Level 2 Science Product Guide
lineage: Publisher or operator text. Local file preserves selected passages and research notes.

passages.locator: LSDS-1619 v2.0, Executive Summary, p. iii
passages.note: Level-2 surface reflectance is derived from Level-1 Landsat 8 OLI measurements. Level-2 land surface temperature uses its separate TIRS stream. The product also carries quality masks. The pre-release technical guide documents product characteristics and does not establish public availability in September.
